content: The 2026 Mining Indaba conference and the 4th Annual African Critical Minerals Summit serve as primary networking and positioning arenas for consultants, though they offer limited archived information on past projects [21] [3] . For instance, the European Union has demonstrated an increasing reliance on African countries for critical minerals, a trend that significantly bolsters the geopolitical positioning and strategic leverage of South Africa in international resource negotiations [35] . The emphasis on local involvement underscores a broader national strategy to ensure that the extraction of South Africa's resources translates into tangible socio-economic benefits for its population. There is a strong June 2026 perspective on South Africa's diminished smelting capacity and its strategic aspirations to reclaim its position in value-added mineral processing [1] .
